summary.text: Chanyu Zhong Er is a Chanyu tribe Gu Immortal who acts as the tribe's representative at an auction, relying on the immortal killer move immemorial flame axe.

claims.text: Over a sandalwood sacred elephant egg he offers He Lang Zi a stake: if He Lang Zi wins, the egg is his; if He Lang Zi loses, He Lang Zi will join Chanyu tribe and serve a hundred years. Hei Cheng, Fairy Jiang Yu, and Xue Song Zi close in without him noticing until they reveal themselves. Jiang Yu says that thinking of fighting He Lang Zi to recruit a rank seven as a goon for the tribe is naive. He calls Hei Cheng a Hei tribe Gu Immortal of Huang Jin bloodline, like Chanyu tribe, and accuses him of colluding with demonic path outsiders against righteous path Gu Immortals. Xue Song Zi says that if it were his big brother Chanyu Shang Yi they would have a headache, and if it were his younger brother Chanyu Xia San they would have given up the ambush, because he has neither the defensive prowess of the one nor the speed of the other. Hei Cheng answers with a dark arrow rather than words.

A pathetic figure flees while a huge wolf that speaks human language calls his name. He yells that he will drag them down with him and uses immemorial flame axe: fire gathers into an axe in midair, the sky glows red, and the wolf’s fur burns before the blow lands. Fairy Jiang Yu teleports He Lang Zi aside so the axe misses, then a black robed Gu Immortal appears behind him and uses soul suction Immortal Gu. Hei Cheng and Xue Song Zi add their souls to that pull. He cannot resist. His soul is drawn out, his body falls like a puppet with its strings cut, and Jiang Yu catches the body. She finds a fire path Immortal Gu in his blessed land. His soul, still held, shouts that their real motive was that Immortal Gu. Jiang Yu says the elephant egg was a target as well, but compared with the Immortal Gu it is only icing on the cake. Qin Bai Sheng is ambushed, and Jiang Yu, the black robed Gu Immortal, and He Lang Zi leave to save him.
